Dialogs.Dialog: Hey. Were you just talking to someone？
Oh, really...? Well, shall we go？
It's been a while... Well, not really, but come to think of it, we haven't talked properly in a while, have we？
Hehe, you look pretty busy spending time with your girlfriend, after all.
Meeting up with her today, too？ I'd hate to get in the way, so I'll get going.
Oh, what a coincidence. ...Hey, is your girlfriend the type to get jealous if you just talk to other girls？
I feel like you don't hang out as much ever since you got a girlfriend... Or is it just me？
Hehe. Are you working hard on being a better man？
Oh, hey, hey. I can still ask you for favors like before, right？ Ah... maybe I'd better not, though.
Don't just fool around with your girlfriend, make sure you take your job seriously, too.
Is having someone special really that fun？ ...Sorry, forget I asked that！
Word is your girlfriend's really cute lately. You're one lucky guy.
Are you two all lovey-dovey？ ...Just kidding, do I sound like an old lady？
Mmm, I'd love to just go cut loose somewhere... ...Ah, sorry, just talking to myself.
Hey, what do you do on your days off？ ...Or is it nosy of me to even ask？
▲主人公＊▲. Chat with me once in a while, okay？
*yawn*... I've been doing nothing but watching movies lately. It's fun losing myself in a hobby, though.
Are you taking proper care of yourself lately？ I guess I don't need to worry, though.
Is tennis practice tough？ Balancing that with work must be hard, but do your best.
Is library committee tough？ Do you ever have to work a shift right after？ Don't push yourself too hard.
▲主人公＊▲. How's it going？ Any problems pop up？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm fine, everything's under control.
Very good. Keep up the good work, okay？
Well, yeah. Even if it's just part-time, it's still work.
Good boy, good boy. I'm rooting for you!
▲主人公＊▲. You aren't pushing yourself too hard, are you？
Eh, no, I'm okay. Did I look like I was overdoing it？
Not necessarily. But you've got a lot going on besides work, right？
I'm fine, really. Thanks for worrying about me.
Let's do our best until the end of our shift today, okay？
▲主人公＊▲. How have things been going lately？
Lately？ Hmm, I think I'm managing without any problems.
I see, that's good then. Keep at it.
▲主人公＊▲. Is anything troubling you lately？
Trouble...？ Not really, I'm doing fine.
That's a relief. If there's anything I can do, don't hesitate to ask, okay？
Yeah, thanks. I'm counting on you.
Hey, are things going well with your girlfriend lately？
Actually, lately things have been a bit...
Hehe, I see. All lovey-dovey, huh？
Lovey-dovey... I don't know about that, haha.
I knew it. I kind of had a feeling. You've gotta treasure her more.
I see... Hey, not that this has anything to do with it, but...
...Never mind, it's nothing. Make sure you two get along, okay？
Oh, hey. If you'd like, would you take this？
Hm... Wait, isn't this ▲特別デートアイテム＊＊▲？
Yeah, I happened to get it, but there's no point in me keeping it.
I'd love to, but are you sure？
Of course. Go have fun with your girlfriend, okay？
Um, there's something I've been wondering about...
You have a girlfriend, so is it a bother that I talk to you so much？
It might not be fair to my girlfriend, true...
It's not a bother at all
...You're right. Yeah, I'll be careful. I'm sorry.
Oh, really...？ That's a relief, then.
We're friends, after all. Don't worry about it.
It's been a while since we had a proper chat, huh？
Would it be okay if I talked to you like before again？
It'd be bad for my girlfriend...
We're friends, so no need to worry about it, right.
Hey, hey. Have you changed lately？
Hmm, just a feeling, but on the inside, you know？
Like, your vibe feels a bit warmer now, I think.
Let's see, like you have kind of a cool vibe... maybe.
Like your vibe's settled down, maybe...？
More active, maybe...？ Yeah, something like that.
Your girlfriend changed her hairstyle, didn't she？
It just caught my eye. I bet she did it for you, don't you think？
Word is your girlfriend's been looking cuter lately.
So you haven't even noticed yourself, huh？
I bet you're the reason why. At least, that's what I think.
Hey, is it true that your girlfriend's been feeling down lately？
Just heard it around. I don't really know, but... anything come to mind？
I won't pry, don't worry. I was just a little curious.
Oh, hey hey. You were walking home with your girlfriend again, right？
Ah... haha, you saw that, huh？
Seems like things are going well between you two.
Ah, look who's being all lovey-dovey.
Shouldn't you know that better than anyone？
Well, I don't mind. You are dating, after all.
(Wait, does she mean the PDA with my girlfriend...？)
The other day, I totally spotted you two on a date.
'Which one'？ My, you two must go on a lot of dates.
(With how often we go, we're bound to get seen...)
Haven't been going out with your girlfriend much lately？
Girls get lonely easily, so make sure you give her plenty of attention.
Fufu, guess I'm butting in. Just some big-sister advice.
Doing that kind of thing at school is... a bit much, don't you think...？
▲主人公＊▲. Looks like things are going well for you lately？
People are talking about you. Saying you've really got things together.
You didn't even realize？ Pretty cool of you.
(I wonder... Come to think of it, things have been working out lately...)
Hey, you two are still dating, right？
Wait... yeah, we are. Why do you ask？
I haven't seen you two together much lately, and people are getting worried.
I won't stick my nose in, but... shape up, okay？
How've things been with your girlfriend？ Just so-so？
Well... yeah, just so-so, I guess.
Doesn't sound like things are going great, then.
Hehe, instead of moping, why not try talking to her more？
So things are going well with your girlfriend？
Well, yeah. I think things are going pretty well.
Well, it's a good thing, isn't it？
Hey, people have been talking about you two lately.
● and me？ What do you mean by that？
In a good way. They say you're the best couple in the whole school.
Like the school's star couple, I guess.
It's written all over your face.
Mm... my girlfriend and I have been fighting a bit lately.
Come to think of it, I haven't really been texting her much...
That's it right there. You've gotta text her, then.
Mhm, good boy. Don't go putting it off, either. Text her right away, okay？
Yeah... I guess we haven't been acting very couple-y lately.
Then... go kiss her. Meet up with her properly.
Um... The other day, I stood her up on a date...
Then you've got to make plans and make up for that date.
Actually, on our last date, I kind of ignored her, so she got mad and went home...
Well... no wonder that turned into a fight.
I think all you can do is keep apologizing until she forgives you.
Hmm, I haven't really been seeing her much lately...
That's no good. I bet she was just lonely...
Call or text, but either way, I think you should reach out to her.
Hey, I saw your girlfriend earlier, and she didn't look so good.
You shouldn't let her push herself too hard... Sorry for butting in.
No, thanks for letting me know.
Is your girlfriend out sick with a cold？
I bet she'd be really happy if you went to visit her.
It was quite a while ago, but... we went out together once, right？
That was before you got a girlfriend, if I remember right.
Nothing, it just popped into my head.
Thinking about it like that, I guess we've been friends for quite a while now.
Um, do you remember...？ Before you got a girlfriend, well... I confessed to you, didn't I？
I'm glad we've stayed friends all this time.
Heading home now？ If you want, do you want to walk together？
I'm walking home with my girlfriend
Sure, I was on my own anyway. Let's go.
Um, I'm meeting up with my girlfriend, so...
Sorry, I'm walking home alone today.
Sorry, did I keep you waiting？
Nah, I was chatting with a friend anyway.
I see. Shall we go, then？
Well, this is my stop. Bye-bye.
Hey... why do you walk home with me？
You wouldn't get it. It's just no fun when you don't have anyone to give chocolates to.
You could just give some to someone.
Geez... It's not like just anyone will do.
White Day, huh. You holding up okay？
With everything. Well, if there's no need to worry, that's fine.
Do you ever get anything, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Well, from the ones I gave to, yeah. But it's mostly just a courtesy thing.
...Not that there's much to celebrate, though.
I mean, I'm just getting one year closer to being an old lady... *sigh*
Oh, thanks. Are you getting me something？
Nope! Leave that sort of thing to your girlfriend.
Don't look so disappointed. Just remembering should be plenty, right？
Christmas, huh... I bet you're having a wonderful time.
Look at you, making such a happy face.
Actually, I wanted to ask for your advice...
Ooh... A present for your girlfriend？ That's sweet.
I wanted a girl's opinion, too. Sorry to bug you, but I could use your help.
All right! I'm gonna give it my all.
You look like you're having fun, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I am! Shopping for your girlfriend... Hehe, cute.
Hello？ It's ▲苗字▲. I have a favor to ask.
A present for your girlfriend... Sounds nice？
Awesome! Thanks, I really wanted a girl's opinion.
So that's why you called... Hehe, leave it to me.
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting.
Thanks for coming on such short notice.
Don't worry about it, you're my junior. Leave it all to your big sis.
Yes ma'am, I'm in your hands!
I think it was over there... Wait right here.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sure seems to be having fun...)
Sorry for running off on you... Did something happen？
Ah, well... ▲彼女＊＊▲ was actually right here.
Hmm, well, I don't think she was mad, but...
Is it my fault...？ I'm sorry.
Don't worry about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. More importantly, how was the present？
You really helped me out today. Thanks a ton.
You're welcome. Hope I was helpful.
Hehe. Glad to hear it. See ya.
Well... you called out to me so suddenly.
I was out shopping alone and spotted you... Looks like you two are out together, huh？
...I see. Well, I'll get going, then.
Hey. If things ever get tough, you can always lean on your big sister, okay？
Well, I'm okay for now. I've got a girlfriend, after all.
I see. If your girlfriend lets you lean on her, that's probably for the best.
(My heart skipped a beat for a second there...)
Nope, nothing. But I bet you've just been all lovey-dovey with your girlfriend again.
Well... I'll leave that to your imagination？
How are things with your girlfriend？ Going well？
If anything happens, I'll have to take her side.
Well of course not. Your big sister is on the side of delicate girls, after all.
Looking at you, sometimes I end up feeling bad for your girlfriend...
You're so innocently laid-back, she must have her hands full.
I don't really think that's true, though...
Is your girlfriend the reason you look so carefree and happy？
Well... being this happy might be thanks to her, yeah！
Letting her boyfriend get so full of himself.
I'm so jealous of your girlfriend...
Having such a cute boyfriend who looks like he'd do whatever she says.
Wait, do I really look like that？
(Do I really do whatever she says...？)
Your girlfriend really is a wonderful girl, isn't she？
Look at you, answering instantly! Though I'd like to think I'm not half bad myself.
Ah, stop! No need to grade me! Hearing it might break my heart, after all.
(I really don't think she has to worry, though...)
Do I lack charm as a woman, I wonder？
I mean, even an easygoing guy like you managed to get a girlfriend, and yet...
That's a pretty harsh way to put it...
(I mean... she's got plenty of charm, right？)
Working hard on things with your girlfriend？
Hmm, don't know if I'm 'working hard', but things are going pretty well.
Even when things get tough, don't let it get you down, okay？
You've got such a lovely girlfriend, after all. You lucky boy.
Hey, if anything happens, you know you can always rely on me, right？
Why do you mention this all of a sudden？
Just had a feeling. Are you doing okay for now？
I see, thanks. I'm fine for now.
You're my cute junior, after all. I've gotta look out for you.
(So that's how she thinks of me.)
Hey, you aren't pushing yourself too hard, are you？
She's a sweet girl, but dating can come with all kinds of stress, you know？
I see. Well, as far as ● goes, I think I'm totally fine!
Geez, look at you getting all full of yourself.
(It's not like I'm pushing myself, anyway.)
Hey, hey, how are things going with your girlfriend lately？
How are they...？ What do you mean？
Oh, you know... all kinds of things...
